title: Français 3234
contents: Fogliani privately criticizes an unidentified person’s handling of the duke’s affairs and says that fuller disclosure would surprise his correspondent.
fields: Not established in the checked postscript

excerpts.folio: f103r, cipher lines1–3; saved editorial reading — 103r
excerpt: **Io n[o]n posso mancare di dire a uostra alteza che mi pare che il [?] non habb[i?] fauorito le cos[e] del signor duca di quel modo che mi pare che douea, essendo lui che gouerna come fa in questi tempi, et se io pitessi dirle ogni cosa in poca scri…**
translation: I cannot fail to tell Your Highness that it seems to me that [?] has not [helped?] the duke’s affairs as he should have, since he governs as he does at present; and if I could tell you everything in a short wri…

excerpt: **…che gouerna come fa in questi tempi, et se io pitessi dirle ogni cosa in poca scrittura, uostra alteza uedria che ha mostratto tenire poco conto di sua ecelenza, che mi ha fatto marauigliare assai, perche non lo haurei mai pensato, e[t] se…**
translation: …who governs as he does at present; and if I could tell you everything in a short letter, Your Highness would see that he has shown little regard for His Excellency. This has greatly astonished me, because I would never have expected it; and if…

excerpt: **io fossi in parte che io le potessi parlare, le direi cose che le parerebb[o]no strane, come parsero a me quando soccesse il fatto.** Io ho inteso in questo punto da una persona degna di fede et homo di qualita…
translation: I were somewhere I could speak to you, I would tell you things that would seem strange to you, just as they seemed to me when the incident occurred. I have just heard from a trustworthy person and a man of standing…
